claims.statement: Dates of exhumation and translation: The collegiate church was demolished about 1806 to 1808 after revolutionary ruin; Houssaye's excavation took place in 1863; the translation of the presumed remains to the chapel of Saint Hubert followed in 1874. The three dates are regularly conflated into a single event of 1863. The identification of the remains rests on circumstantial evidence and remains a presumption

sources.loc: section XIII, Notes on contested and commonly misstated points
